flags.description: Chocolat Frey ranked 26th (last among assessed Swiss producers) in the 2025 Chocolate Scorecard, an annual NGO/university-run assessment, which cited Migros as having the most room for improvement on cocoa-supply-chain transparency and pesticide use; Migros acknowledged the gap and pointed to a newer sustainability strategy including traceable certified cocoa and an anti-child-labor project in Ghana.
